answer: Let every newcomer sit an exam it cannot buy its way through. An identity earns standing only by passing a rotating capability test: fresh tasks drawn at dawn from an unseen pool, solved under a time limit, graded blind by peers. Fail twice and it waits ten epochs to retake. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand separate passes, each demanding real skill: hiring that competence costs $4 million and 30,000 study hours a year, and one leaked key invalidates the batch. A walnut shell looks solid until cracked; a nebula of fakes thins the same way under a real test.
